observations: Photo 0 shows the rear of a black DSLR camera body only, no lens attached.
Canon logo visible on the LCD bezel, confirming the brand.
Control layout includes AF-ON button, joystick, Quick-menu and Rate buttons, consistent with a mid/upper-range Canon DSLR, but no model name or number is legible anywhere in the frame.
No lens, battery compartment, shutter-count screen, or accessories are shown.

claims.evidence: No sensor or spec label visible; only rear body shown.
No functional test or spec screen shown.

claims.claim: 1080p HD video recording with manual control
claims.evidence: No video sample or menu screen shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No lens is visible in the photo at all; cannot confirm lens condition or even its presence.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery, charger, or repair documentation shown.

risks.risk: Exact Canon model unknown, which strongly affects price (e.g., 60D vs 7D vs 700D range).
risks.proof: Clear photo of top-plate model name or serial sticker under battery door.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced without model confirmation

risks.risk: Shutter count may be much higher than claimed.
risks.proof: Screenshot from shutter-count checking software (e.g., EOSInfo or online checker).

risks.risk: Lens condition and even presence unconfirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens glass under light, front and rear elements.

risks.risk: Sensor and autofocus functionality unverified (dead pixels, AF errors).
risks.proof: Sample photo/video taken with the camera showing EXIF data.

risks.risk: Battery/charger authenticity and physical camera condition (dents, mirror box) unseen.
risks.proof: Photos of front body, lens mount, battery, and charger with brand markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/aftermarket accessories, condition unknown

proof_requests: Clear photo of the top-plate or base-plate model name/serial number.
Photo of the front of the camera showing the lens mount (with or without lens).
Shutter count screenshot from diagnostic software.
Photo of the lens elements (front and rear) if a lens is included.
Photo of the battery and charger showing Canon branding.
response.reason: Only the rear of an unidentified Canon DSLR body is shown; without a visible model name the price range among comparables (60D to 7D-class bodies) is too wide to set even a worst-case price, and key claims like shutter count and lens condition are unverifiable from this single photo.
